articles.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
articles.snippet: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

articles.title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
articles.snippet: Binance said attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.

articles.title: How to Run an AI Model Locally—And Why You Might Want To
articles.snippet: Free tools like Ollama and LM Studio can run open-weight AI models on your laptop, offline, and without a subscription. Here's how to get started.
